recognize_zh: 紅血球堆成不規則、立體的葡萄串狀大團塊，並非直線錢串狀排列，旁邊還有散在的鋸齒狀紅血球（echinocytes）與一個分葉核嗜中性球，典型的紅血球凝集表現。
features: Large irregular three-dimensional clusters of overlapping red cells in a grape-like pattern
Aggregates are non-linear, distinguishing agglutination from rouleaux
Scattered crenated red cells (echinocytes), likely artifactual
Single segmented neutrophil and a few platelets
Individual red cells between clumps are largely normocytic
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows prominent red cell agglutination, with large irregular, three-dimensional clusters of erythrocytes rather than linear rouleaux. Scattered crenated red cells are present, likely a drying artifact. A segmented neutrophil and scattered platelets are seen. Findings are consistent with red cell agglutination, as seen in cold agglutinin-mediated autoimmune hemolytic anemia; correlation with a warmed specimen, DAT (C3d), and cold agglutinin titer is recommended.

ddx.vs: Rouleaux are linear coin-stack arrays and disperse with saline replacement, whereas agglutinates are irregular clumps.
Warm AIHA shows spherocytes with IgG-positive DAT and does not typically form large agglutinates.
Artifactual clumping is limited to thick areas and lacks the persistent grape-like aggregates at the thin edge.
